packages.title: Usage refresh no longer resets the task screens
brief: Context: b7 round 2 ran P95. Reviewer B (verify-b7-r2-B.md) found UX-505, UX-506 and UX-507 fixed in code, and one regression, R2B-1, now UX-511 (S2). First attempt. Evidence is inferred from code (the provider chain read end to end) and needs a phone.

UX-511 (R2B-1, S2, from P95). After every successful upload by a free account, P95's `api.refreshStorage` (attachment_store.dart, the block after `_pullRemote`, about :296-306) goes through `_remember` (api_client.dart:237-259), which emits `accountUpdated`. `AuthNotifier` (auth_provider.dart, the `_accountUpdated` listener) sets `state = AuthState(account: account)`, a new `Account` object. `taskRepositoryProvider` (App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart:13-18) watches `authProvider.select((value) => value.account)`, the whole object, so it builds a new repository; `taskProvider` (:20-23) builds a new `TaskNotifier`, which starts at `AsyncValue.loading()`. Result: task_detail_screen.dart:98-100 / :469 turns into a spinner Scaffold with no app bar and comes back scrolled to the top, right where the user just attached the file; calendar_screen.dart:266 briefly shows an empty day; home_screen.dart:481 briefly shows a spinner. Then one more full sync runs. The same chain runs after each dictation through `rememberFreeVoice`.

Fix by depending on less, not by adding anything. In App/lib/providers/task_provider.dart:14 watch only which account is signed in: `final accountId = ref.watch(authProvider.select((value) => value.account?.id));`, return the local `TaskRepository(TaskDatabase())` when it is null, and pass `accountId` to `CloudTaskRepository` (it only ever used `account.id`). groups_provider.dart, project_scope_provider.dart and invitations_provider.dart already select `account?.id` this way; follow them.

Same cause, same change: App/lib/services/capture_store.dart:16 (`captureOwnerProvider`) also watches the whole `account` but only uses `account.id`. Select `s.account?.id` there too, so an account update doesn't recompute the owner key and reload `pendingCapturesProvider`. (Organizer's reading of the same chain; the reviewer didn't name this file.)

With this, an account update repaints only what watches the changed field: the usage line (`attachment_panel.dart:151` and :171 watch `account.storage`), and the free-dictation lines (`subscription_provider.dart:68` and :77). The extra full sync after an account update goes away. Sign-in, sign-out and a switch to another account still change the id, so they still rebuild the repository. Becoming Pro does not rely on the rebuild: main.dart:297-302 calls `retryRefused()` and `loadTasks()` itself.

Update the now-wrong comment in attachment_store.dart above the refresh ('The account update runs one more sync, which uploads nothing, so this can't loop.'): it can't loop because the account update no longer rebuilds the repository or starts a sync. Update the matching comment in App/test/attachment_store_test.dart:426 the same way, and keep that test's assertion that no further `auth/me/` request is made.

Don't touch: `_remember` and `refreshStorage` (don't add the optional skip-unchanged emit; it isn't needed once the repository ignores account updates), `AuthNotifier`, the attachment panel, any copy. If a test in the full suite relied on the second sync after an account update, report it in your notes instead of restoring the whole-account watch.
No copy change, so no ARB edit and no gen-l10n.
acceptance: Widget test: TaskDetailScreen for a task with files, pumped with the real `taskRepositoryProvider` and `taskProvider` (not overridden), a free account saved at 78 of 100 MB, English, scrolled down to the files section. A sync uploads a queued file and `auth/me/` answers `storage` 82 MB. During and after it, no CircularProgressIndicator replaces the screen, the app bar stays, the scroll offset is unchanged, and 'Files: 82 of 100 MB used' shows.

Unit test: with a signed-in account, an `accountUpdated` that changes only `storage` (or only `free_voice`) leaves `taskRepositoryProvider` the same instance and `taskProvider` never goes back to loading. No second `sync()` runs.
Unit test: signing out and signing in as a different account still gives a new repository whose owner key names the new account.
Unit test: `captureOwnerProvider` keeps the same value and `pendingCapturesProvider` doesn't reload after an account update that changes only `storage` or `free_voice`.
Code: task_provider.dart and capture_store.dart select `account?.id`, not the whole account.
deviceChecks: On a free account, open a long task, scroll to the bottom and attach a photo: the screen stays put, with no blank flash and no jump to the top, and the file shows as uploaded. Repeat above 80%: the 'Archivos: … de 100 MB usados' line appears without the screen resetting.

packages.title: Catalan free-dictation dates: no doubled full stop
brief: Context: UX-503 failed once. Last attempt (P94, b7 round 2): Catalan got 'dia' before the date (app_ca.arb:875-878), so the 1st no longer reads 'el 1 de nov.'. Reviewer A (verify-b7-r2-A.md) marked it partly fixed, and ux-tester's acceptance test fails: `DateFormat.MMMd('ca')` (capture_messages.dart:14; region.dart:16 via subscription_screen.dart:60) formats 1 November as '1 de nov.', with its own full stop, and two Catalan sentences end in '{date}.'. The user reads 'en tindràs més el dia 1 de nov..' (capture sheet) and 'Més el dia 1 de nov..' (Pro screen). The plan's own Catalan copy had the same doubled stop.

Why not just drop the final stop: 'març', 'maig' and 'juny' have no abbreviation dot, so those months would end with no stop at all. Move the date away from the end of the sentence instead. Catalan only.
App/lib/l10n/app_ca.arb:875 `freeVoiceUsedUp` → `Ja has fet servir els dictats gratuïts d’aquest mes. La pots escriure aquí; el dia {date} en tindràs més.`

App/lib/l10n/app_ca.arb:878 `freeVoiceStatus` → keep `Dictats gratuïts: {left, plural, =1{et queda 1} other{et queden {left}}} de {limit} aquest mes.` exactly, and change only the last sentence from `Més el dia {date}.` to `El dia {date} en tindràs més.`
Don't touch: `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` (a comma follows its {date}, so it's fine), `freeVoiceLeft`, `captureClose`, every EN and ES string, and the date helpers. Run `flutter gen-l10n`.

The failing test, App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart (the UX-503 test, about :997-1030): change its name to describe the new wording, change `contains('el dia 1 de nov.')` for `freeVoiceUsedUp` to `contains('el dia 1 de nov. en tindràs més')`, change `endsWith('Més el dia 1 de nov.')` for `freeVoiceStatus` to `endsWith('El dia 1 de nov. en tindràs més.')`, keep the `a partir del dia 1 de nov.` check, the plural checks and the `isNot(contains('..'))` loop.
acceptance: Unit test: in Catalan, with 1 November, `freeVoiceUsedUp` ends with 'el dia 1 de nov. en tindràs més.', `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` contains 'a partir del dia 1 de nov.', and `freeVoiceStatus(4, 10, …)` reads 'Dictats gratuïts: et queden 4 de 10 aquest mes. El dia 1 de nov. en tindràs més.'. None of the three contains '..'.
Unit test: in Catalan, with 1 May, `freeVoiceUsedUp` and `freeVoiceStatus` end with 'en tindràs més.' and contain 'el dia 1 de maig' (a month with no abbreviation dot still reads correctly).
Unit test: the ES and EN texts of `freeVoiceUsedUp`, `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` and `freeVoiceStatus` are unchanged; `freeVoiceStatus(1, 10, …)` in Catalan still contains 'et queda 1'.
Widget test: the capture sheet in Catalan at 2× text on 320 dp, with free dictations used up and words kept, shows the used-up line ending 'el dia 1 de nov. en tindràs més.' with no overflow.

packages.title: File size limit says 6 MB everywhere
brief: Context: b7 round 2 ran P96, which changed `fileUploadHelp` to say '6 MB'. Reviewer D (verify-b7-r2-D.md) found UX-508, UX-509 and UX-510 fixed in code, and one regression, R2D-1, now UX-512 (S1). First attempt. The sibling strings still say '6 MiB': task_editor.dart:367-369 and :816-817 show `fileLocalHelp` or `fileUploadHelp` in the same spot, and the too-big snackbar (task_editor.dart:351 and :410) shows `fileLimit`. 'MiB' is also jargon for a first-time user.

In all three ARB files change '6 MiB' to '6 MB' in `fileLocalHelp`, `fileLimit` and the `fileLimit` branch of `requestError`. Change nothing else in those strings, and no other branch of `requestError`.

EN: `fileLocalHelp` (app_en.arb:921) → `Files stay on this device until you sign in and choose Upload in task details. Up to 6 MB per file.`; `fileLimit` (:922) → `Choose a non-empty file up to 6 MB. You can attach up to 20 files per task.`; `requestError` (:43) branch → `fileLimit{Choose a non-empty file up to 6 MB.}`

ES: `fileLocalHelp` (app_es.arb:551) → `Los archivos permanecen en este dispositivo hasta que inicies sesión y elijas Subir en los detalles de la tarea. Hasta 6 MB por archivo.`; `fileLimit` (:552) → `Elige un archivo no vacío de hasta 6 MB. Puedes adjuntar hasta 20 archivos por tarea.`; `requestError` (:24) branch → `fileLimit{Elige un archivo no vacío de hasta 6 MB.}`

CA: `fileLocalHelp` (app_ca.arb:530) → `Els fitxers es queden en aquest dispositiu fins que iniciïs la sessió i triïs Puja als detalls de la tasca. Fins a 6 MB per fitxer.`; `fileLimit` (:531) → `Tria un fitxer no buit de fins a 6 MB. Pots adjuntar fins a 20 fitxers per tasca.`; `requestError` (:25) branch → `fileLimit{Tria un fitxer no buit de fins a 6 MB.}`

Don't touch: App/lib/l10n/request_locale.dart:98 (`message.contains('6 mib')` matches the server's text and the internal message below), App/lib/services/attachment_files.dart:45 (`FormatException('Choose a non-empty file up to 6 MiB.')` is never shown as-is: task_editor.dart:409-410 shows `fileLimit` for a FormatException, and elsewhere request_locale.dart:98 maps that text to `fileLimit`, so changing it would break the mapping), and the code comment at attachment_store.dart:230. Those are not user-facing copy.
Run `flutter gen-l10n`. Update any existing test that looks for the old '6 MiB' copy.
acceptance: Grep: 'MiB' appears in none of App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb, app_es.arb, app_ca.arb.
Unit test: `fileLocalHelp`, `fileLimit` and `requestError('fileLimit')` contain '6 MB' and not 'MiB' in EN, ES and CA; `fileLimit` still says 20 files per task.
Unit test: the internal message 'Choose a non-empty file up to 6 MiB.' still maps to `fileLimit` through request_locale.dart, and in Spanish shows 'Elige un archivo no vacío de hasta 6 MB.'.
Widget test: the task editor in Spanish, signed out with a local file, shows the help text ending 'Hasta 6 MB por archivo.'; signed in, it shows 'hasta 6 MB cada uno'.
